suppress.notes: CVE-2026-53914: code execution via unsafe deserialization in Kotlin build cache metadata. Build-time only, not reachable in the deployed service. Fixed in Kotlin 2.4.20, which still has no stable release (2.4.20-RC2 as of 2026-08-28). Remove this suppression when Kotlin 2.4.20 is released and the plugins are bumped.

CVE-2026-54285: unbounded baggage-header parsing in W3CBaggagePropagator.extract(). This is a JavaScript vulnerability in the npm package @opentelemetry/core (fixed in 2.8.0, GHSA-8988-4f7v-96qf), not in the Java library. Dependency-check matches it through the generic cpe:2.3:a:opentelemetry:opentelemetry CPE, so every Java 1.x version sorts below the 2.8.0 fix and no bump can ever clear it. @opentelemetry/core is not present in api-gateway/yarn.lock or frontend/yarn.lock.
